# The Hack Collective

> London's hackathon community. 1,000+ builders, one WhatsApp group, every London hackathon on one calendar.

Founded in London in September 2025 by UCL students, run on WhatsApp and Luma.

## Facts

- 1,000+ members
- 400+ Luma calendar subscribers
- #2 on Google for London Hackathons
- 2026 UCL Campaign of the Year nominee

## Partners

- Kickstart Global, Hacker's Unity, HackEurope, FINEDA
